definition: Total net revenues of the firm after deducting interest expense, representing aggregate top-line gross resources available for allocation across operating expenses, capital retention, and shareholder returns.
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Consolidated Statements of Earnings / Operations / Income
comparability_notes: Directly comparable across all 8 firms. Universally reported on the face of the Consolidated Income Statement.
known_limitations: For BHCs, includes market-making net interest margin and principal transactions; for boutiques, almost entirely fee-based advisory revenue.

economic_category: Financial Resources / Core Advisory & Underwriting Revenue
definition: Revenues derived from investment banking activities, comprising financial advisory (mergers & acquisitions, restructuring) and capital markets underwriting (equity and debt underwriting).
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Segment Reporting Footnote / Consolidated Statements of Earnings
comparability_notes: Directly comparable across all 8 firms. Reflects gross fee generation from underwriting and advisory engagements.
known_limitations: Boutiques (EVR, LAZ, MC) generate nearly 100% of revenue from advisory/underwriting; BHCs (GS, MS, JPM) and SF have diversified streams (sales & trading, wealth management, commercial banking).

definition: Actual gross cash payments made during the fiscal year for dividends on common stock, preferred stock, and non-controlling partnership distributions.
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (Financing Activities)
comparability_notes: Directly comparable across all 8 firms. Measured on actual cash outflow basis from audited financing cash flows, avoiding board authorization timing mismatches.
known_limitations: For Up-C boutiques (EVR, MC), includes distributions to non-controlling interest holders (operating partnership units) alongside corporate dividends.

definition: Actual cash paid to repurchase common shares and treasury stock, including open-market purchases, accelerated share repurchase contracts, and shares acquired to satisfy employee tax withholding obligations.
numerator: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock / Treasury Stock Acquired
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (Financing Activities)
comparability_notes: Directly comparable across all 8 firms. Represents actual realized cash outflows for equity retirement.
known_limitations: Distinguishes discretionary market buybacks from anti-dilutive net share settlements for stock-based compensation vesting; cash flow statement captures total realized cash outlay.

definition: Aggregate gross cash returned to equity holders during the fiscal year, calculated as the sum of actual cash dividends paid and actual cash spent on share repurchases.
accounting_basis: Derived from U.S. GAAP Cash Flows
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (Financing Activities)
comparability_notes: Directly comparable across all 8 firms. Formally linked to underlying audited primary cash flow components.
known_limitations: Does not account for offsetting cash inflows from stock options exercised or new share issuances; measures gross capital returned.

definition: Annualized return on average common shareholders' equity, reflecting accounting earnings generated per unit of total common equity.
numerator: Net Income Applicable to Common Shareholders
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Item 7 MD&A Financial Highlights / Executive Overview
comparability_notes: Directly comparable across Bank Holding Companies (GS, MS, JPM, SF) and JEF. STRUCTURALLY_NON_COMPARABLE for advisory boutiques (EVR, LAZ, MC) due to Up-C partnership structures and legacy capital deficits.
known_limitations: Distorted by differences in leverage, intangible assets, and deferred tax assets across institutions.

display_name: Return on Average Tangible Common Equity (ROTCE / ROTE)
economic_category: Subsequent Financial Performance / Core Capital Productivity
definition: Return on average tangible common equity, measuring core earnings generated per dollar of tangible common equity excluding goodwill and identifiable intangible assets.
numerator: Net Income Applicable to Common Shareholders
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Item 7 MD&A Non-GAAP Financial Measures Reconciliation
comparability_notes: Directly comparable within BHC Panel A (GS, MS, JPM report ROTCE; SF reports ROTE; JEF reports ROTE). NOT_APPLICABLE for boutiques (EVR, LAZ, MC).
known_limitations: Non-GAAP metric; management definitions vary slightly regarding amortization of intangibles added back to the numerator.

definition: Ratio of total non-interest operating expenses to total net revenues, measuring the proportion of revenues consumed by operational overhead.
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Item 7 MD&A Financial Highlights / Executive Overview
comparability_notes: Comparable within BHC Panel A (GS, MS, SF report Efficiency Ratio; JPM reports Overhead Ratio; JEF reports Non-Interest Expense Ratio). NOT_APPLICABLE for boutiques (which manage to compensation ratio).
known_limitations: JPM terms this 'Overhead Ratio'; GS, MS, and SF term this 'Efficiency Ratio'. Lower values indicate superior cost discipline.

economic_category: Regulatory Capital Retention / Basel III Solvency
definition: Common Equity Tier 1 risk-based capital ratio calculated under the Basel III Standardized Approach, measuring core regulatory loss-absorbing capital as a percentage of standardized risk-weighted assets.
accounting_basis: Regulatory Capital (Federal Reserve Basel III Rules)
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Item 7 MD&A Capital Resources / Regulatory Capital Disclosures
comparability_notes: Directly comparable across BHC Panel A (GS, MS, JPM, SF). NOT_APPLICABLE for JEF (broker-dealer holding company under SEC Rule 15c3-1) and NOT_APPLICABLE for advisory boutiques (EVR, LAZ, MC).
known_limitations: G-SIBs (GS, MS, JPM) are subject to SCB (Stress Capital Buffer) and G-SIB surcharges; SF is Category IV (no G-SIB surcharge). Under Collins Amendment, Standardized Approach serves as the binding capital floor.

definition: Tier 1 Leverage Ratio under Federal Reserve regulations, measuring Tier 1 regulatory capital as a percentage of quarterly average total consolidated on-balance-sheet assets less regulatory deductions.
denominator: Average Total Consolidated Assets less Deductions
accounting_basis: Regulatory Capital (Federal Reserve Basel III Rules)
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Item 7 MD&A Capital Resources / Regulatory Capital Disclosures
comparability_notes: Directly comparable across BHC Panel A (GS, MS, JPM, SF). NOT_APPLICABLE for JEF, EVR, LAZ, MC.
known_limitations: Measures unweighted on-balance-sheet leverage constraint; excludes off-balance-sheet derivatives and commitments (captured under SLR).

economic_category: Regulatory Capital Retention / Comprehensive Leverage Buffer
definition: Supplementary Leverage Ratio under Basel III rules, measuring Tier 1 regulatory capital against total leverage exposure including both on-balance-sheet assets and off-balance-sheet exposures.
denominator: Total Leverage Exposure (On- and Off-Balance Sheet)
accounting_basis: Regulatory Capital (Federal Reserve Basel III Advanced Approaches / Category I)
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Item 7 MD&A Capital Resources / Regulatory Capital Disclosures
comparability_notes: Directly comparable for Category I G-SIBs in Panel A (GS, MS, JPM). NOT_APPLICABLE for SF (Category IV regional bank exempt from SLR rules). NOT_APPLICABLE for JEF, EVR, LAZ, MC.
known_limitations: Temporary exclusion of central bank reserves and U.S. Treasuries expired in Q1 2021, creating an exogenous regulatory baseline shift between 2020 and 2021.

definition: Total common shareholders' equity less goodwill and identifiable intangible assets, measuring physical and liquid accounting equity available to absorb losses.
numerator: Total Common Shareholders' Equity less Goodwill and Intangibles
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Item 7 MD&A Non-GAAP Financial Measures / Balance Sheet Footnotes
comparability_notes: Directly comparable across BHC Panel A (GS, MS, JPM, SF) and JEF. STRUCTURALLY_NON_COMPARABLE for advisory boutiques.
known_limitations: Non-GAAP metric widely reported by banks; treatment of deferred tax liabilities associated with intangibles varies across reporting entities.

definition: Operating expenses for communications, information services, market data, and technology infrastructure recognized within non-interest operating expenses.
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Consolidated Statements of Earnings / Non-Interest Expense Footnote
comparability_notes: PARTIALLY COMPARABLE. Disclosed as a discrete line item by GS, MS, JPM, SF, and JEF. Excludes capitalized software and hardware investments (capex); captures ongoing technology run-rate opex. Quarantined from unified cross-firm pooling.
known_limitations: High-risk variable; definitions differ across firms (e.g., market data vs cloud compute vs telecommunications). Does not represent total capital investment.

definition: Total consolidated assets of the banking entity at fiscal year-end, representing the aggregate scale of the firm's balance sheet under U.S. GAAP.
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Consolidated Statements of Financial Condition
comparability_notes: Directly comparable across BHC Panel A (GS, MS, JPM, SF) and JEF. Reflects balance sheet intermediation and market-making inventory. NOT_APPLICABLE for comparing against asset-light advisory boutiques.
known_limitations: Includes repo/reverse repo netting, collateralized financing, and trading inventory that fluctuate with market conditions.

economic_category: Human Capital Investment / Primary Resource Allocation
definition: Total salary, incentive compensation, equity-based compensation, and employee benefits expense recognized during the fiscal year.
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Consolidated Statements of Operations / Earnings
comparability_notes: Directly comparable across boutiques (EVR, LAZ, MC) as the core resource allocation mechanism (typically 55%-70% of revenues). Also reported by BHCs and JEF.
known_limitations: Includes vesting amortization of prior-year deferred stock awards; sensitive to grant-date fair value accounting and performance accruals.

definition: Total compensation and employee benefits expense as a percentage of total net revenues, measuring the proportion of top-line revenue allocated to human capital.
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Item 7 MD&A Results of Operations
comparability_notes: Core operating and capital allocation metric for Panel B advisory boutiques (EVR, LAZ, MC). Directly comparable across boutiques. Derived from primary GAAP income statement lines.
known_limitations: Adjusted compensation ratios reported by boutiques exclude one-time acquisition bonuses or restructuring charges; this data dictionary tracks the primary reported/derived GAAP basis.

definition: Net revenues less total operating expenses (compensation and non-compensation expenses), representing operating surplus before non-operating items and taxes.
numerator: Net Revenues less Total Operating Expenses
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Consolidated Statements of Operations
comparability_notes: Directly reported by advisory boutiques (EVR, LAZ, MC). STRUCTURALLY_NON_COMPARABLE for BHCs, which do not report an 'operating income' line due to bank accounting conventions (reporting pre-tax income).
known_limitations: Boutique operating income includes partner distribution expense variations under different legal structures.

definition: Operating income divided by total net revenues, measuring operational profitability after absorbing compensation and non-compensation overhead.
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Consolidated Statements of Operations / MD&A
comparability_notes: Directly comparable within Panel B advisory boutiques. STRUCTURALLY_NON_COMPARABLE for BHCs.
known_limitations: Sensitive to revenue volatility in M&A cycle and fixed non-compensation overhead absorption.

definition: Total cash, cash equivalents, and short-term liquid marketable investments held by the firm, representing unencumbered liquidity buffers.
numerator: Cash and Cash Equivalents (+ Short-Term Investments)
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Consolidated Statements of Financial Condition
comparability_notes: Directly comparable within Panel B advisory boutiques (EVR, LAZ, MC) as direct unencumbered liquidity. STRUCTURALLY_NON_COMPARABLE for BHCs where cash reflects fractional reserves and central bank balances.
known_limitations: May include restricted cash or regulatory escrow deposits if not broken out on face of balance sheet.

definition: Aggregate carrying value of funded long-term debt obligations, senior notes, and credit facility borrowings.
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Consolidated Statements of Financial Condition
comparability_notes: Directly comparable within Panel B advisory boutiques (EVR has 0 debt; LAZ carries senior notes; MC carries revolving borrowings/notes). STRUCTURALLY_NON_COMPARABLE for BHCs.
known_limitations: Excludes operating lease liabilities under ASC 842; focuses on funded debt obligations.

economic_category: Capital Retention / Boutique Net Balance Sheet Cushion
definition: Total cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments minus total funded long-term debt, representing net liquid balance sheet reserves.
accounting_basis: Derived from U.S. GAAP Balance Sheet
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Consolidated Statements of Financial Condition
comparability_notes: Directly comparable within Panel B advisory boutiques. Positive indicates net cash cushion; negative indicates net debt. NOT_APPLICABLE for BHCs.
known_limitations: Derived metric; does not include working capital receivables or accrued compensation obligations.

definition: Operating expenses for communications, market data feeds, software licenses, and IT infrastructure disclosed within non-compensation expenses by advisory firms.
primary_source_type: SEC Form 10-K Consolidated Statements of Operations / Non-Compensation Footnote
comparability_notes: PARTIALLY COMPARABLE. Disclosed by EVR and LAZ. UNAVAILABLE for MC, which bundles IT into general and administrative non-compensation expenses without breakout. Quarantined from cross-firm pooling.
known_limitations: High-risk variable; incomplete coverage across Panel B (MC missing). Captures operating expense, not capital expenditure.
